title: Pause + Return
concept: Turns “space” into a connected intervention by pairing separation with a non-negotiable return time — Protection without disappearance.
whenToUse: When either partner is Flooded/Shutdown — racing heart, tunnel vision, contempt, urge to flee or win. Any time safety or regulation drops below what honest conversation needs.
steps: Signal: “I need a pause.” No justification required.
Time: Set return time (min 15 minutes; max 24 hours): “I’ll be ready at ___.”
Separate: Down-regulate (walk, shower, breathe, music). Avoid rehearsing arguments.
Return: Reconnect at the agreed time — even briefly — to prove pause, not disappearance.
Restart: Warmth → Safety (not “where we left off”).

phrases.text: I’m not leaving you; I’m getting regulated.

working: A: “I’m flooded. I need a pause. I’ll be ready at 8:30.” B: “Okay. Thank you for giving a time. I’ll see you at 8:30.” They return at 8:30, even for two minutes, then restart with Warmth.
notWorking: “I need space.” (walks away) “We’ll talk later.” — “Later” is not a return time. The other nervous system experiences abandonment. Fix: add a concrete clock time.
activity: Agree default duration (e.g., 20 min) and max (24h). Write phrases on this card. Practice one low-stakes rep this week; keep the return exactly.
warn: If Green Rule is broken, stop content — this tool first.
